mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app WHERE isDelete = 0 AND deployKey IS NOT NULL AND deployKey != '' AND visibility = 'plaza'

SELECT a.id, a.appName, a.cover, a.initPrompt, a.codeGenType, a.genStatus, a.deployKey, a.deployedTime, a.priority, a.visibility, a.userId, a.editTime, a.createTime, a.updateTime, a.isDelete FROM app a LEFT JOIN app_like al ON a.id = al.appId WHERE a.isDelete = 0 AND a.deployKey IS NOT NULL AND a.deployKey != '' AND a.visibility = 'plaza' GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY COUNT(al.id) DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
